The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `6443` (see `K3sBuilder.KubeSecurePort`)
- Port: `8443` (see `K3sBuilder.RancherWebhookPort`)
- Command: `server --disable=traefik`
- Mount: `/sys/fs/cgroup`
- Mount: `/run`
- Mount: `/var/run`
- Privileged: `true`
- Create parameter: `HostConfig.CgroupnsMode="host"`
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `Node controller sync successful` is logged.
